calibrate_zero.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) executes zero point calibration command on the sensor with the given ID.

co2.docs:
The CO2 data from the sensor in parts per million (ppm). All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [CUBIC CM1106 Single Beam NDIR CO2 Sensor Module](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/cm1106#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for actions.

*See also: [CUBIC CM1106 Single Beam NDIR CO2 Sensor Module](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/cm1106#configuration-variables)*

uart_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart) if you want to use multiple UART buses.

*See also: [CUBIC CM1106 Single Beam NDIR CO2 Sensor Module](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/cm1106#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [CUBIC CM1106 Single Beam NDIR CO2 Sensor Module](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/cm1106#configuration-variables)*
